case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 8819 OF 2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 8820 OF 2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 8821 OF 2022

parties.petitioner: Ramesh Chandra Sharma & Ors.; Anoop Singh (Dead) Thr. Lr(s). & Ors.; Jageshwar Singh @ Jage (Dead) Thr. Lr(s). & Anr.

summary: Classification of landholders as 'Pushtaini' (ancestral) vs 'Gair-pushtaini' (non-ancestral); validity of differential compensation under Land Acquisition Act, 1894; historical context of land ownership in Gautam Budh Nagar; distinction based on acquisition date and family lineage; Full Bench ruling upholding classification affirmed; nexus with rehabilitation objective established; etymological analysis of classification terms; prior compensation rulings in Gajraj upheld; no discrimination found in payment structure; appeals dismissed maintaining compensation disparity.
legal_provisions_cited: U.P. Land Acquisition (determination of compensation and declaration of award by agreement) Rules, 1997
Nagpur Improvement Trust vs Vithal Rao (1973) 1 SCC 500
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; Full Bench judgment of Allahabad High Court upheld; distinction between 'Pushtaini' and 'Gair-pushtaini' landholders in compensation payment validated.
